decision_feature: number of distinct parsed answers in the single Target response at probe depth
thresholds: Choose integer answer-count threshold 1..20 independently per anchor on three training folds. Require at least 20 early exits and zero baseline-success breaks in training; maximize final-context saving. Otherwise never exit early. Evaluate only on the fourth fold.
cost: Charge probe and fallback calls, including prompt and generated tokens. This is a train-side OOF diagnostic, not a deployable or independently validated cutoff.
